messages:
alex: Quick sync — change window starts 20:00 PST. We have one hotfix for embeddings quality (regen delta on prod). Need a freeze-exemption for a single canary-only deploy.

maria: what's the risk surface? will this touch model weights or just routing?

alex: routing + param tweak; no model re-upload. config flag flip + light canary. low risk but touches caching layer.

sam: ok to exempt canary only. if we do this we must pin canary to v2026.3 and ensure automatic fallback to v2026.2 if latency > 200ms for 5m.

tara: I can own the smoke checks and tracing. I'll post the exact asserts to run.

deploy-bot: @alex requested: pin v2026.3 -> canary group "embed-canary". TTL 2h. Action: pin applied. :white_check_mark:

oncall-sre: noted. oncall will monitor tail-drop and error spike dashboards. paging threshold set to 5% error for 3m.

maria: we need a rollback playbook in-thread. Sam, can you paste the exact commands?

sam: rollback steps:
```bash
# force traffic back to previous tag
deploy route --service embeddings --to-tag v2026.2 --percentage 100
# unpin canary
deploy pin --service embeddings --remove embed-canary
```

alex: add note: if memory growth > 1GB over baseline in 10m, trigger immediate rollback.

tara: smoke checks I'll run (10m after canary): top-5 queries, embedding cosine drift, p95 latency, redis hit rate. posting results at 10m mark.

maria: release notes snippet for ops channel: "Embeddings: canary config tweak to improve regen recall. Canary pinned v2026.3 for 2h. Watch embeds.p95 and cache_hit. Rollback plan ready."

deploy-bot: canary metrics report incoming in ~10m.

deploy-bot: canary metrics: p95=142ms, errors=0.3%, mem_delta=+120MB, cache_hit=87% — within thresholds. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

oncall-sre: no alerts. continuing watch.

alex: okay to lift freeze for canary only and proceed. All owners acknowledged. :thumbsup:

maria: documenting exemption: reason=low-risk routing tweak; duration=2h; approvers=[alex,maria,sam]; rollback_ready=true.

sam: will be standing by for rollback if any spike.

tara: posting smoke check results: all green. final status: canary stable at 30m. recommending promote per rollout plan.

alex: thanks team — promote window tomorrow morning 02:00 UTC if no regressions. I'll update release notes and close thread.

maria: closing ack. :white_check_mark:
